title: delissea lydgatei
intro: Delissea lydgatei, commonly known as Ma'o hau hele, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. It is native to Hawaii and has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The plant is said to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, and has been used to treat conditions such as fever, sore throats, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Delissea lydgatei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
